content: अर्चा [अर्च्-अङ्] .²1 Worship, adoration; अर्चायामेव हरये पूजां यः श्रद्धयेहते <ls>Bhāg. 11. 2. 47</ls>. .²2 An idol or image intended to be worshipped; मौर्यैर्हिरण्यार्थिभिरर्चाः प्रकल्पिताः <ls>Mbh. 5. 3. 99</ls>. (there is some dispute among scholars as to the precise meaning of this passage); अर्चापूजाप्रतिमयोः <ls>Nm.</ls>
